items.name: Google Playground
items.why: 一個實驗性的 AI 平台，讓用戶無需編碼即可透過文字提示創建可玩遊戲，直接實現「創建遊戲的助手」功能。

items.name: Google and Unity AI Gaming Platform
items.why: Google 的 AI 能力與 Unity 遊戲引擎深度整合，為開發者提供 AI 驅動的互動體驗、自適應 NPC 和程序化內容生成工具。
items.why_en: Deep integration of Google's AI capabilities with the Unity game engine, providing developers with tools for AI-driven interactive experiences, adaptive NPCs, and procedural content generation.

items.name: Gemini 4 Argon
items.why: 已全面發佈，展示了從頭開始構建完整項目（包括網頁賽車遊戲和 Godot 引擎遊戲）的能力，並支援多代理視覺評估循環。
items.why_en: Generally available, demonstrating the ability to build complete projects from scratch, including web-based racing games and Godot engine games, with multi-agent visual critique loops.

items.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
items.why: 以「願望驅動編程」為核心，能夠從頭開始創建遊戲和 3D 模型等完整項目，並已開源。
items.why_en: Centered on 'Wish-Driven Programming,' capable of creating complete projects from scratch, including game creation and 3D modeling, and released as open-source.

items.name: GPT-6 Astra
items.why: 於上月發佈，被譽為軟體工程領域的「世代飛躍」，作為通用編程模型對遊戲開發具有廣泛應用潛力。
items.why_en: Released last month, hailed as a 'generational leap' in software engineering, offering broad potential for game development as a general-purpose programming model.
